questions.prompt: How clearly do your plans for using AI or automation connect to a business goal?

options.label: We have not identified a specific business goal.

universal_persona_copy: Use you and anyone who helps you; do not presume a formal team, IT department, or governance committee.
not_applicable_policy: All 14 universal indicators apply to every audience; no N/A answer is supported in V1. Applicability belongs to conditional evidence probes only.
